notes.title: 🗼 Soon available on Steam: Family Adventures - Paris!
notes.content:
🗼 Soon available on Steam: Family Adventures - Paris!

Greetings, puzzle lovers!

We're happy to announce our own developed game: Family Adventures - Paris. Be part of an incredible journey with the Millers family, loving parents Peter and Emily, talented Jessica, and sporty Steven - as they travel to the French capital, exploring the beautiful streets and experiencing the culture, art, and history that Paris holds for them. 

[h1][b]Wishlist now:[/b][/h1]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2445970/Family_Adventures_Paris/

Get ready to turn on your brain and show your strategic skills by solving six different puzzletypes along the adventure of 50 mysteries. From exciting Match 3 challenges to tricky Hidden Object scenes, from challenging jigsaw puzzles to strategic Onet, Drag 'n Drop and Frogger. Each puzzle presents a unique call to test your observation, pattern recognition, and quick-thinking skills. 

[h1]Available Q3 2024[/h1]

notes.title: Meet our newest puzzle game!
notes.content:
[h1]Imagine yourself being in the greatest musea by solving the Jigsaw Puzzles of master artists like Monet, Haring, Kadinsky, Hokusai, Rousseau and Rembrandt. [/h1]

[img]https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/39580520/842ac8ef5a17d54734374ddd772610c673a7870f.jpg[/img]

All major art style are represented in more dan [b]100 high quality puzzles[/b]. Enjoy the modern UI and 4 difficulty levels (30/120/300/600 pieces).

notes.title: Soon available on Steam: Puzzle Pieces 4: Farewell Dear Winter
notes.content:
We are more thant to share this news with our Steam family, a new game full of puzzles is available soon. Puzzle Pieces 4: Farewell Dear Winter will be released on February 23.
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=iqNnaIE1Dos
[h1][b]Puzzle Pieces 4: Farewell Dear Winter[/b][/h1]
With this Jigsaw gameplay and dazzling collection of puzzles, the beauty never stops. The pictures are a mix of beautiful winter and spring scenes. There are a lot of options to choose, from puzzle shape and number of pieces. You will love to [b]use your own images[/b] and create puzzles from them.

Please visit the Steampage and add this awesome puzzlegame to your [b]wishlist [/b] now:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2269720/
